category_title: Credit recovery students with self-discipline and engagement challenges
scenario_title: Reading-dominant online courseware with social embarrassment
minimal_context: The student is logging into the NovaNET online courseware to complete a reading assignment during a summer credit recovery session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please log into the NovaNET online courseware and begin the reading assignment for today's summer session.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm logged in, but I'm already having difficulties with the amount of reading demanded of us here. It's just walls of text.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best to read through the material.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't focus on all this. Before this summer, I didn’t pay much attention and had messed up priorities, so I'm not used to reading this much on my own.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: If you get stuck on a section, you can just ask me a question about it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not going to keep asking questions about every single page. I'm just going to skip the reading and guess. Usually I'd just avoid this by being distracted, by my friends, or sleeping in class.
